events.verdict: Dort (OKC) firms up on his right foot in McDaniels' (MIN) path and marginal contact occurs as they come together during the pick. Reid (MIN) rests his hand on Dort's back as he sets the pick and that contact is also marginal.
Dort (OKC) grasps and immediately releases Gobert's (MIN) jersey shorts as they briefly engage and disengage during the pick.
Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) contests McDaniels' (MIN) shot attempt and any follow-through contact to McDaniels' front after the release is marginal.
Hartenstein (OKC) rests his hands on Gobert's (MIN) body and marginal contact occurs as DiVincenzo (MIN) secures the rebound.
Gobert (MIN) fumbles the ball upon receiving the pass from DiVincenzo (MIN) and any follow-through contact with Wallace (OKC) as both players pursue the loose ball is deemed incidental.
DiVincenzo (MIN) and Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) mutually engage and disengage with one another and marginal contact occurs off-ball.
McDaniels (MIN) briefly places two hands on Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) body and marginal contact occurs as Gilgeous-Alexander slightly extends his right arm to disengage during the drive.
Williams (OKC) makes clean contact with the ball and deflects it away from Reid (MIN) during the steal.
Reid (MIN) legally goes into the backcourt to retrieve the loose ball after it is deflected by Wallace (OKC).
Hartenstein (OKC) briefly rests his left hand on DiVincenzo's (MIN) shoulder and marginal contact occurs during the driving shot attempt.
Reid (MIN) avoids making any illegal contact with Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) arm on his dislodge attempt during Gilgeous-Alexander's driving shot attempt.
Dort (OKC) legally contests Edwards' (MIN) jump shot attempt.
Reid (MIN) makes clean contact with the ball and any follow-through body contact with Hartenstein (OKC) as they come together during the rebound is deemed marginal.
Alexander-Walker (MIN) rests a hand against Wallace's (OKC) side and the contact does not affect his SQBR.
Wallace (OKC) briefly grasps and immediately releases DiVincenzo's (MIN) jersey as marginal contact occurs during the inbound.
Dort's (OKC) left hand is resting on Reid's (MIN) body and gets briefly caught in Reid's jersey. The contact is marginal as Reid releases away in an attempt to secure the errant inbound pass.
